groups.title: Match the Words with Definitions - Titanic

options.text: a small boat to save people on board if the ship sinks
a person who continues to live after danger
to go down below the surface or towards the bottom of a liquid or soft substance
a large mass of ice floating in the sea

sentences.full_sentence: iceberg: a large mass of ice floating in the sea
sentences.translation: الجبل الجليدي: كتلة كبيرة من الجليد تطفو في البحر

sentences.full_sentence: lifeboat: a small boat to save people on board if the ship sinks
sentences.translation: قارب النجاة: قارب صغير لإنقاذ الناس على متن السفينة إذا غرقت

sentences.full_sentence: to sink: to go down below the surface or towards the bottom of a liquid or soft substance
sentences.translation: يغوص / يغرق: ينزل تحت السطح أو نحو قاع سائل

sentences.full_sentence: survivor: a person who continues to live after danger
sentences.translation: الناجي: شخص يستمر في الحياة بعد الخطر

options.text: because they didn't believe that they were in danger.
it had taken lifeboats enough for only 1178 people.
had ever travelled on the sea.

sentences.start: The Titanic was carrying 2207 people, but
sentences.full_sentence: The Titanic was carrying 2207 people, but it had taken lifeboats enough for only 1178 people
sentences.translation: كانت تيتانيك تحمل 2207 أشخاص، لكنها حملت قوارب نجاة تكفي فقط لـ 1178 شخصاً

sentences.start: Many passengers had not dressed warmly,
sentences.full_sentence: Many passengers had not dressed warmly, because they didn't believe that they were in danger
sentences.translation: لم يرتدِ العديد من الركاب ملابس دافئة، لأنهم لم يعتقدوا أنهم في خطر

sentences.start: The ship had received 6 warnings when
sentences.full_sentence: The ship had received 6 warnings when it struck the iceberg
sentences.translation: كانت السفينة قد تلقت 6 تحذيرات عندما اصطدمت بجبل الجليد

sentences.start: It had not changed its direction or
sentences.full_sentence: It had not changed its direction or its speed after 6 warnings
sentences.translation: لم تغير اتجاهها أو سرعتها بعد 6 تحذيرات

sentences.start: The Titanic was the largest ship that
sentences.full_sentence: The Titanic was the largest ship that had ever travelled on the sea
sentences.translation: كانت تيتانيك أكبر سفينة سافرت على البحر على الإطلاق

groups.title: Match the Sentence Parts - Back to Life

options.text: and luckily landed in a haystack

sentences.start: I had never seen snow until
sentences.full_sentence: I had never seen snow until I went to Canada
sentences.translation: لم أرَ الثلج أبداً حتى ذهبت إلى كندا

sentences.start: The bus fell into a river
sentences.full_sentence: The bus fell into a river and four passengers drowned
sentences.translation: سقطت الحافلة في النهر وغرق أربعة ركاب

sentences.start: The train crashed in a river after
sentences.full_sentence: The train crashed in a river after it left the tracks
sentences.translation: تحطم القطار في النهر بعد أن خرج عن القضبان

sentences.start: he was blown out of the plane's door
sentences.full_sentence: he was blown out of the plane's door and luckily landed in a haystack
sentences.translation: تم قذفه من باب الطائرة وبالحظ هبط على كومة قش

sentences.start: I had arrived at the station
sentences.full_sentence: I had arrived at the station before the train left
sentences.translation: كنت قد وصلت إلى المحطة قبل مغادرة القطار
